`halt`: stop the computer.

## Synopsis

<strong>halt</strong>

## Description

<strong>halt</strong> flushes its output and asks the kernel to halt the system. Every process ends and its open files are closed, so what was written reaches the disks; then the CPU stops. The machine's power stays on, and the screens keep what they show. Arguments are ignored.

To turn the machine off, use <strong>poweroff</strong>(1); to start again, use <strong>reboot</strong>(1) or the power button.

## Exit status

On success <strong>halt</strong> does not return. If the kernel refuses, it prints the reason on standard error and exits with 1.

## See also

<strong>poweroff</strong>(1), <strong>reboot</strong>(1), <strong>kill</strong>(1)
